## Musik 1.12.4

- **Updates in the right order:** Settings → Updates has an "Update all" button. It updates the app first. When the app has restarted, the server update runs by itself.
- The server button waits with "Update the app first" while the app is out of date.
- If the app is older than your server, a bar at the top says so and updates the app with one tap.
